slides.say: You click a tab that is slow to render, then change your mind. With use transition, the second click is handled right away.
Use transition returns is pending and start transition. State updates inside start transition are marked as Transitions.

slides.text: Transitions are non-blocking and can be interrupted by other updates.
slides.say: Transition updates run in the background without blocking the page. If another update comes in, like typing, React handles it first, then restarts the transition work.

slides.text: The function you pass is called an Action.
slides.say: The function you pass to start transition is called an Action.
